| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Circles | Circles, Accumulator | The found circles as a table, drawn on the canvas, or the accumulator as an image. |
| **Edge smoothing** `sigma` | 1 | 0.5 to 5 px | The sigma of the Gaussian blur before Canny finds edges. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Low threshold** `lowThreshold` | 0.1 | 0 to 2 | Weak edges must reach this Sobel magnitude, on the luma from 0 to 1. scikit-image uses 0.1. |
| **High threshold** `highThreshold` | 0.2 | 0 to 2 | Strong edges must reach this Sobel magnitude. scikit-image uses 0.2. A value below the low threshold counts as the low threshold. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Smallest radius** `minRadius` | 5 | 2 to 200 px | The smallest radius to look for. |
| **Largest radius** `maxRadius` | 50 | 2 to 200 px | The largest radius to look for. A value below the smallest radius counts as the smallest radius. |
| **Radius step** `radiusStep` | 1 | 1 to 20 px | The step between the radii that are tried. |
| **Share threshold** `threshold` | 0.5 | 0.05 to 1 | A circle needs at least this share of the points on its circle to be edge pixels. |
| **Most circles** `circles` | 10 | 1 to 200 | At most this many circles, the strongest first. |
| **Distance apart** `minDistance` | 5 | 1 to 100 px | Two centers of one radius must be at least this far apart in x or in y. |
